question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH constructor_yearly_combined AS (
    SELECT r.year, c.name, rs.constructor_id, 
           MAX(rs.points) as constructor_points, 
           MAX(r2.points) as best_driver_points,
           MAX(rs.points) + MAX(r2.points) as combined_points
    FROM constructor_standings rs
    JOIN constructors c ON rs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    JOIN races r ON rs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN results r2 ON r.race_id = r2.race_id AND rs.constructor_id = r2.constructor_id
    GROUP BY r.year, c.name, rs.constructor_id
),
constructor_max_combined AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, name, MAX(combined_points) as max_combined_points
    FROM constructor_yearly_combined
    GROUP BY constructor_id, name
)
SELECT name, max_combined_points
FROM constructor_max_combined
ORDER BY max_combined_points DESC
